pros: Extremely simple to understand and implement
Computationally efficient with O(V) time complexity
Intuitive interpretation: more connections = more importance
No parameters to tune or configure
Works as a solid baseline for comparing complex algorithms
cons: Only considers local structure, misses global network patterns
Treats all connections equally, ignores neighbor importance
Cannot distinguish between connections to important vs peripheral nodes
Highly sensitive to network size when not normalized
Fails to capture bridge nodes that connect different communities
